BiblicalUsage: Challamiysh is flint, the hardest rock. God brought water out of the rock of flint for thirsty Israel, Job says man puts his hand upon the rock and overturns mountains, the psalm says the flint was turned into a fountain of waters, and the Servant set His face like a flint.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe flint is the Bible's picture of two things at once: the rock that gives water when God strikes it, and the face that will not turn aside. Hardness is a curse in one verse and a calling in the other.
